### 📌 Epidemic intelligence: key findings of the week

[Week of 12 October 2026]{.weekly-date}

- **🐦 HPAI, new event in Chinese Taipei**: H5N1 in poultry in Taipei (event started 8 August 2026). Only 3 poultry outbreaks were reported worldwide in August, in line with the seasonal low in the Northern hemisphere.
- **🐦 HPAI in mammals, USA**: H5N1 outbreaks in a cat and in a mustelid were reported in August 2026, after outbreaks in cattle in July.
- **🐦 HPAI, first detection in a wild bird in New Zealand**: H5N1 in a subantarctic skua in Wellington (8 July 2026).
- **🐦 HPAI in wild birds, record season**: 7,444 outbreaks in wild birds since October 2025 (to 31 August), against 1,926 in the whole previous season, mostly in Europe.
- **🐖 African swine fever, new areas in Europe**: Finland reported its first occurrence of ASF in wild boar (24 July 2026), and Hungary its first occurrence in a zone, in domestic pigs in Somogy (6 August 2026).

- **🦌 Wildlife, classical swine fever in Asia and the Pacific**: CSF emerged as the third most-reported wildlife disease in Q1 2026, with 451 outbreaks, all in wild boar in Asia and the Pacific. It did not feature in the previous quarter.
- **🦌 Wildlife, rabies in new countries**: first occurrence of rabies in wildlife in Chad, Congo (Rep. of the), Israel, Moldova and Romania (January–March 2026).

Sources: [HPAI situation reports 85–86](avian-influenza/index.qmd) · [ASF situation reports 79–80](african-swine-fever/index.qmd) · [Wildlife situation report Q1/26](wildlife/index.qmd)
:::
